# LeadPilot AI CRM — Release Notes v2.4.0 (CI/CD Pipeline Hardening)

**Release Date:** July 27, 2026  
**Milestone:** CI/CD Pipeline Hardening & Infrastructure Alignment  

---

## Highlights

- **CI Lockfile Resolution**: Configured `actions/setup-node@v4` with `cache-dependency-path` targeting subfolder lockfiles (`leadpilot-ai/package-lock.json` and `leadpilot-ai/leadpilot-frontend/package-lock.json`).
- **Working Directory Standardization**: Added `defaults.run.working-directory` ensuring commands execute in target project roots without path resolution errors.
- **Pipeline Hardening**: Enabled concurrency cancellation, 15-minute step timeouts, artifact uploads, and separate frontend and backend verification jobs.
